description: Run a read-only GA4 Data API report for a property over a date range. Returns dimension/metric rows (e.g. event counts by eventName). Useful for reconciling configured GTM/GA4 events against events GA4 actually reports (zero reported activity for a configured event is a red flag). Read-only — never writes. Requires the analytics.readonly scope.

dimensions.description: Dimension names, e.g. ["eventName","date"]. Max 9. Omit for a metric-only report.

metrics.description: Metric names, e.g. ["eventCount","totalUsers"]. At least 1, max 10.

orderByMetric.description: Metric name to order by (descending). Optional.

name: ga4_run_report
